listenings.text: Hey, it's Diane. I'm calling you back, finally. Sorry, it's late. How are you? I'm okay, but I am very tired, because it was a long day and I only slept four hours. The morning was fine. The afternoon was busy, because we had three meetings and nobody stopped for lunch. And the weather here is terrible, so nobody wants to go out. But tomorrow is better, I think. Tomorrow I have only one meeting, in the morning, and then I am free. So, how is your week? Call me when you can. Not now, please. Now I am going to sleep. Talk to you later.

Good morning, everyone. This is your host with the plan for today. First, the weather. It is cold this morning, about four degrees, but the afternoon is much better, around fifteen, and there is no rain. So today is a good day to walk. Second, the schedule. Breakfast is open until ten, and the car is here at eleven, not at ten thirty, because the traffic is very bad on Fridays. Third, and this is the important one. Tonight we are eleven people at dinner, and the restaurant is small, so please be there at eight. Not eight fifteen. Eight. That is all. Have a great day, and see you tonight.

extra_audio.text: Hi. How are you today? I'm fine, thank you. I am a little tired, because it was a long day. But tomorrow is better. And you? How is your week?
